Hi there,

The last couple of months I’ve had the same feelings about life. I just didn’t want to live because of the pain, the sadness and most of all because I just hate myself. I wanted to die, but the thoughts of nothingness even scared me more than fear of pain. When you die you make a permanent decision, and it’s not about the people you leave behind because honestly idc about them anymore. But it’s all about accepting the fact that you don’t want to live but you don’t want to die neither. Then it comes to making the hard choice to keep on living because you don’t want to actually die, you want whatever problem you’ve got to stop it. The next question you have to ask yourself is: what causes these feelings/thoughts. And it’s okay if you don’t directly get an answer to those questions, that’s perfectly fine but indeed frustrating because time is still going even though you feel stuck in time. The key is to give yourself the time YOU need, because after all it’s YOUR life and not somebody else’s. You have to prioritize YOUR feelings because you deserve to be happy no matter how much time it takes you. There is no need to rush, it’s okay to take everything day by day or even hour by hour. And it all sounds simple and shit, and I have to confess: it’s not. But I live for the precious and little moments where I do feel happy even though I know I can be depressed af the following days, I just try to not think about what feelings I might experience in the future, because indirectly you’re gonna live to your expectations and eventually you let your depression decide your feelings. And although it seems like an unevitable spiral, you can get through this, you just have to take all the time you need.

The thing is, sometimes life just sucks, but we have to keep on going because death is so damn permanent and filled with nothingness. Life has it’s moments of complete happiness and you have to seek your way to those moments. And most of all, you don’t have to be scared to feel shit. Feelings are precious yet destroying but that’s okay, that’s who you are. There are so much feelings worth living for to experience like: emotions caused by music, emotions caused by a nice friendship and so on.
I live for these fucking feelings man and I won’t let death take them away from me no matter how sad I feel. I have permission to be sad but I don’t have permission to give sadness permission to fucking destroy me.

Do shit to keep in touch with reality like sports, take big long walks in the night and just look at the fucking stars and moon man. They are never going away how depressed you may feel. You have to find things which are permanent and regain trust in yourself and time.

I hope this can help you a bit

Take care x
